2026 law extract held with the match file: Law 21.15 and the scoring laws: runs from a ball struck by the bat are credited to the striker, apart from separately recorded penalty awards.
2026 law extract held with the match file: The bowling analysis debits batter runs and No-ball or Wide extras to the bowler, but not Byes, Leg byes or five-run penalties.

2026 law extract held with the match file: Law 41.5: wilful deception after the striker receives the ball makes it dead, prevents dismissal, makes the ball not count, awards five Penalty runs and retains completed plus current running.
2026 law extract held with the match file: Laws 17.3 and 20.7: an ordinary legal delivery counts as one valid ball unless a stated exception directs otherwise.

2026 law extract held with the match file: Law 19.8: for an overthrow boundary, add the boundary allowance, runs completed at the instant of the throw, and the run in progress if the batters had already crossed then.
